title: Voice in My Knives
album: Lucro Sucio; Los Ojos Del Vacio

lyrics.text: When the heart you shouldn't lose becomes estranged
Oh, yeah, who'll fix the pain?
When the lineage of trauma just won't break
Let it rain
Listen to the call, it's gon' rain
So let it rain
That voice in the knives
Shielded by night
When the options, they have crumbled
When the absolutes refuse to let you go
What festers in your heart, they lost you as a child
And you never wanted thеm to look away (Just look away)
Now the time has come, I fеar that it's too late
And the penance for sedition blinds the flock
Yes, it does
But the branded nervous system still remains
They all know
That voice in my knives, shielded by night
And the coffins that you filled will never rest
Let it rain
From the remnants of a name only you'd remember
Don't say it 'cause it happens every time
What festers in your heart when they lost you as a child
And you never wanted them to look away (Just look away)
Now the time has come for us to look away
Oh-oh
